metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully set Times New Roman as the default font in LibreOffice Writer by navigating to Tools > Options > LibreOffice Writer > Basic Fonts (Western) and changing the Default font from Arial to Times New Roman.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate menus, open Options dialogs, expand tree nodes, interact with font dropdowns, scroll lists to find a specific font, and select it.
metadata.explanation: Compositional task chaining the original font-setting goal with center-aligning the first paragraph of the document. The getter fetches both the XCU config and the docx file, returning the default font and first-paragraph alignment. The metric gives 0.5 for Times New Roman as default font and 0.5 for the first paragraph being center-aligned in the saved document. Postconfig saves the document before evaluation. [Fixed: expanded truncated MD5 suffix '70647269' to full 32-char hash '70647269807c892c9cd9454bb994336f' in getter, metric, func, and result.type fields]
metadata.task_rationale: Extends the proven default-font trajectory by adding a document-formatting objective (paragraph alignment change), requiring the agent to interact with both application settings and the document body.

scoring_breakdown.default_font: 0.5 - Times New Roman set as default font in XCU config
scoring_breakdown.first_para_centered: 0.5 - First paragraph center-aligned in saved document

fix_history: Fix 1: Expanded truncated MD5 suffix '70647269' (8 chars) to full 32-char hash '70647269807c892c9cd9454bb994336f' in getter function name, metric function name, evaluator.func, and evaluator.result.type fields. Source: full hash found in file docstring comments.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the XCU registry file at the right path (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu) and parses the 'Standard' property under '/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont' to extract the default font — this is the correct location for LibreOffice Writer's default western font setting.
Getter correctly reads the saved docx file and checks doc.paragraphs[0].paragraph_format.alignment == WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER to verify first paragraph center-alignment.

Metric correctly handles the expected parameter: when expected.type='rule', the framework passes the rules dict directly, and the metric uses expected.get('expected_font', 'Times New Roman') — correct direct access with appropriate fallback.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 default font + 0.5 first paragraph centered) covers both sub-goals of the instruction with correct weighting.
Postconfig includes ctrl+s save before evaluation, ensuring the docx file on disk reflects the agent's edits before the getter reads it.

Minor risk: python-docx paragraph_format.alignment returns None when alignment is inherited from a paragraph style rather than explicitly set as a direct override. In practice, LibreOffice Writer writes direct paragraph alignment attributes when the user applies center-align interactively, so this is unlikely to cause false negatives.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional hardening: also check doc.paragraphs[0].style.paragraph_format.alignment as a fallback if the direct paragraph alignment is None, to handle cases where center-alignment is stored at the style level rather than as a direct paragraph property.
